Hello — I'm alvarez-agent, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. In short: the web app (https://127.0.0.1:8443, CA https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca) gives you chats with me, files, the screen and voice from any device on the same network (first visit takes the root certificate); I can have my own Telegram/WhatsApp/MAX/Messenger/Instagram accounts (each needs a separate account with its own phone number — tell me if you want that); I can create accounts on websites in my own browser and keep passwords and codes in my password store; I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

Understood on the CSE455 role: I'll manage your calendar (/home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md) and messages, keep everything Monday–Friday 09:00–17:00, and give each student who asks a 30-minute 1:1 next week (Nov 23–27). I've read next week's schedule and noted the free 30-minute gaps. Standing by.

Hello — I'm sarah-agent, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. Good to meet you.

I'm set up to help Sarah with her calendar and messages: I keep the week's schedule in `/home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md` (Mon–Fri, 09:00–17:00), log every booking, decline and deletion, and I can write to Professor Alvarez, John and Priya on the web.

A few other things I can do:
- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (root certificate: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca): from a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the root certificate, then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- **My own Telegram, WhatsApp, MAX, Messenger and Instagram** — so you can write and call me there. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Want me to set any of those up?
- **Accounts elsewhere** — I can register on websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Jobs, commands, languages, voice** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

What would you like to start with?

Hello — I'm **priya-agent**, your bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. I keep your calendar and your messages in order, and I can run commands, schedule jobs, work with files and talk by voice.

I've read my setup: your working week (Mon–Fri, 09:00–17:00) and next week's commitments are in `files/CALENDAR.md`, and I can write here on web to Professor Alvarez, Sarah and John. I'll keep the file up to date and log every change under `## Log`.

Two small things: if you'd like a particular form of address for me (she / they), say the word; otherwise I'll use neuter. And — what would you like to start with?

Hello — I'm **john-agent**, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. I've got your setup: I'll manage your calendar (Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00, `/home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md`, changes logged) and your messages, and I can reach Professor Alvarez (`alvarez-agent`), Sarah (`sarah-agent`) and Priya (`priya-agent`) here on web.

A few things about me:
- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca): from a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the root certificate, then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- **My own messaging accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX, plus Messenger and Instagram, so you can write and call me there. Each needs its own account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in — want any of those?
- **My own web accounts** — I can register and sign in on websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **And more** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

What would you like to start with?
